claims: SpaceX successfully launched a Falcon 9 rocket carrying 29 Starlink satellites from Cape Canaveral, Florida, on March 22, 2026, at 10:47 a.m. EDT.
The first-stage booster of the Falcon 9 rocket landed on a droneship in the Atlantic Ocean.
The launch location was Space Launch Complex 40 (SLC-40) at Cape Canaveral Space Force Station.
NASA's Artemis II rocket is expected to launch between April 1st and April 6th, 2026.
NASA's Artemis II rocket had a successful rollout to the launch pad on March 20, 2026.
Cygnus CRS-2 NG-24 is scheduled for April 8, 2026, from Cape Canaveral.
